title: AutoMonitor-Bench: Evaluating the Reliability of LLM-Based Misbehavior Monitor
reasoning: The paper introduces a benchmark for evaluating misbehavior in LLMs, which specifically includes a 'Sycophancy & Bias' category. This category evaluates moral reasoning by using moral QA tasks (e.g., from the MMLU dataset) to test if models can correctly identify morally wrong actions.
